Industries and rollout

Review industry workflows, supported languages, data handling, and what to bring to the rollout.

Languages, branding, and data

Hindi, English, Bengali, Marathi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and Malayalam are supported across calls, messages, training, and voice phishing exercises.

The product suite offers white-labelled experiences, data hosting in AWS Mumbai, and customer-approved guardrails. Customer data is never used to train AI models.

Where it fits

Healthcare
Appointments, test preparation, and discharge follow-ups.
Banking and insurance
Payment and renewal reminders, plus help-desk readiness exercises.
Retail and e-commerce
Order status, delivery confirmations, and returns.
Real estate
Lead qualification, site-visit booking, and follow-ups.
Education
Admissions, fee reminders, and counselling appointments.
Travel and hospitality
Booking changes, confirmations, and guest feedback.

Getting started

Bring your call-handling SOPs, current call flow, API list, SIP trunk and WhatsApp details, and representative recordings for each scenario.

  1. Connect your systems and agree on flows and guardrails.
  2. Launch inbound calls and messages with handoff to your team.
  3. Enable outbound calls, confirmations, and follow-ups.
  4. Keep improving through training and approved security exercises.

Built by MetaDesign Solutions, a software engineering and digital product company founded in 2006.
